note: Maps PH6 internal concepts to professional/standards equivalents. PH6 is not claiming conformance. This crosswalk supports communication, future audit readiness, and professional alignment.

crosswalk.ph6_description: Compressed Replay Archive and Manifest — preserves raw evidence packets, hashes, audit chain
crosswalk.professional_equivalent: Evidence preservation container / digital forensic acquisition image
standards_reference: SWGDE Best Practices for Digital Evidence Collection
crosswalk.alignment_note: CRAM mirrors forensic acquisition principles: integrity-preserved, hash-authenticated, chain-of-custody-tracked.

crosswalk.ph6_description: Authority integrity digest — BLAKE2b-256 is the sole canonical hash; SHA-256 is compat sidecar only
crosswalk.alignment_note: Hash-based integrity is standard forensic practice. BLAKE2b-256 provides strong integrity. SHA-256 sidecar preserves interoperability.

crosswalk.ph6_description: Lane-1 deterministic measurement producing PASS/DROP verdicts — replay-stable, authority-final
crosswalk.professional_equivalent: Validated measurement method / deterministic test procedure
crosswalk.alignment_note: ISO/IEC 17025 requires validated methods with known uncertainty. PSEUDO is the PH6 equivalent: fixed algorithm, reproducible output, bounded domain.

crosswalk.ph6_description: Advisory AI interpretation layer — Authority ZERO, cannot issue PASS/DROP, cannot write canon
crosswalk.professional_equivalent: Expert advisory / non-authoritative analysis / opinion layer
crosswalk.alignment_note: FRE 702 requires expert opinions to be distinguishable from fact. PH6's Lane-2/SoSo boundary enforces this: interpretation is labeled, not mixed with measurement.

crosswalk.ph6_description: Metadata taxonomy describing context, environment, and system state at acquisition time
crosswalk.professional_equivalent: Evidence metadata / system context record / acquisition environment log
standards_reference: SWGDE Best Practices for Digital Evidence Collection
crosswalk.alignment_note: Forensic standards require documenting acquisition environment. Token topology is the PH6 structured equivalent.

crosswalk.ph6_description: Automated scan of PH6_SOURCE for forbidden terms, schema violations, lane authority leakage
crosswalk.professional_equivalent: Policy compliance check / configuration audit / security control assessment
crosswalk.alignment_note: SSDF and 800-53 recommend automated policy and configuration checks. PH6 governance scan is a domain-specific implementation.

crosswalk.ph6_description: Deterministic replay verification — same input produces same hash output as original acquisition
crosswalk.professional_equivalent: Reproducibility check / hash verification / forensic verification
crosswalk.alignment_note: ISO/IEC 17025 requires reproducibility of measurement methods. Replay MATCH is PH6's deterministic reproducibility control.

crosswalk.ph6_description: Snapshot of known-good desktop/status interface files with manifest and restore script
crosswalk.professional_equivalent: Change-control rollback / configuration baseline / system state snapshot
crosswalk.alignment_note: Configuration management families in 800-53 require rollback capability. PH6 restore points implement this for the desktop interface layer.

crosswalk.ph6_description: Controlled catalog of registered test methods with commands, work directories, and artifact globs
crosswalk.professional_equivalent: Controlled method catalog / standard operating procedure index
crosswalk.alignment_note: ISO/IEC 17025 requires documented and controlled test methods. test_registry.json is the PH6 method catalog.

crosswalk.ph6_description: Operator control surface — launches registered tests, monitors output, browses artifacts, shows status. Authority ZERO.
crosswalk.professional_equivalent: Operator interface / monitoring station — not authority engine
crosswalk.alignment_note: The interface layer must not contaminate measurement authority. CISA Secure by Design: security built into the design, not bolted on. Desktop authority boundary enforces this.

crosswalk.ph6_description: Authority store for PASS frames — .blake2b marker written last, immutable after sealing
crosswalk.professional_equivalent: Evidence preservation store / write-once forensic archive
standards_reference: SWGDE Best Practices for Digital Evidence Collection
crosswalk.alignment_note: Write-once, hash-authenticated storage mirrors forensic evidence preservation requirements.

crosswalk.ph6_description: Append-only JSONL audit trail with event hashes linking each entry to the prior
standards_reference: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 AU (Audit and Accountability)
crosswalk.alignment_note: Forensic standards require tamper-evident chain-of-custody logs. PH6 audit chain implements this with cryptographic linking.

crosswalk.ph6_description: Prototype source/version-control layer. Not the final production evidence-storage authority.
crosswalk.professional_equivalent: Source code management / software configuration management
crosswalk.alignment_note: Git answers: what code was running at this commit. CRAM answers: what was measured and preserved. Evidence authority comes from CRAM chain, manifests, hashes, replay records, and operator logs — not git commit history. Production PH6 must support storage backends independent of git.

storage_doctrine.statement: Git is the prototype source/version-control layer. It is not the final production evidence-storage authority.

storage_backends.role: Prototype source control; optional metadata/version layer only

storage_doctrine.rule: Production PH6 must support storage backends independent of git. Git may record metadata (script hash, git HEAD) as context but is not a required evidence link.
